method: Each Saturday the model publishes a projected winner and each housemate's eviction risk for the coming week. After Sunday's eviction we score: did the projected winner survive (hit/miss), and Brier scores for the eviction outcome. Rows are appended by src/score_week.py (run after each Sunday eviction once the exit rows land in data/raw/manual_notes.csv, or automatically as run_weekly.py's score_previous catch-up stage) — never edited by hand. Weeks with no published snapshot predating their eviction get a scored:false tombstone explaining why, once. Eviction model: within the nominated set, Cox relative hazards normalise to p_evict(h) = hazard(h) / sum(hazard over nominees); Brier = mean of (p − y)^2 over nominees, y = 1 per exit (double evictions each count). Poll concordance (when docs/polls.json has the week) compares poll save-% order to the snapshot's hazard order over their common housemates; exact ties count as agreement.
